_comment: Extra art sources mirrored into the same tree. Each entry names a release package whose public/assets/** is extracted and uploaded ADDITIVELY: only paths the main (upstream) tree does not have are written, so an extra source can never overwrite the authoritative bytes. Data, not code — adding a source is one entry.
_overrides: Paths where this repository deliberately serves bytes upstream does not ship — the one place the CDN knowingly diverges from upstream, and the only way it can serve something else under a path upstream also ships. Each entry pins the bytes' identity `{ path, size, sha256, why }`; the bytes themselves live in this repository under `pin/<path>`. The sync applies them to the index BEFORE it is serialized and hashed, so the cache token, the acceptance gate's expectations, tree.json and the byte sample all describe what is served, and it verifies `pin/<path>` hashes to the pin before uploading. A pin for a path upstream does not ship is refused (that is an addition, and the additive source path already covers those).
_why: The fusion branch ships full skins, full voice (including jp) and complete operator spines that upstream does not. Its manifest lists 3,980 paths upstream never references, and they share the same relative paths (assets/…), so hosting them is purely additive.
